title: "Calculator: Sample data statistics"
author: Tom Coleman and Millie Harris
format: html
abstract-title: Summary
abstract: A calculator to provide a statistical summary of a sample of data you have taken.
---

```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
library("webexercises")
```

## Sample data statistics calculator

```{=html}

<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Sample Data Statistics Calculator</title>

  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 1rem;
      color: #222222;
    }

    .sdsc-app {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(300px, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-card {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid #dddddd;
      border-radius: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-card-header {
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      color: #ffffff;
      background: #3F6BB6;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-card-body {
      padding: 1rem;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-label {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-textarea {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 290px;
      padding: 0.7rem;
      border: 1px solid #cccccc;
      border-radius: 5px;
      color: #222222;
      background: #ffffff;
      font: 0.95rem/1.5 "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
      resize: vertical;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-help {
      margin: 0.55rem 0 0;
      color: #555555;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-button {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 44px;
      margin-top: 1rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
      border: 1px solid #31558f;
      border-radius: 5px;
      color: #ffffff;
      background: #3F68B6;
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-button:hover {
      background: #31558f;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-error {
      min-height: 1.4em;
      margin-top: 0.65rem;
      color: #b00020;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-notice {
      min-height: 1.4em;
      margin-top: 0.4rem;
      color: #555555;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-table-wrapper {
      width: 100%;
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 0.96rem;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-table-caption {
      padding: 0 0 0.75rem;
      color: #555555;
      text-align: left;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-table th,
    .sdsc-app .sdsc-table td {
      padding: 0.72rem 0.8rem;
      border: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
      text-align: left;
      vertical-align: top;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-table th {
      color: #ffffff;
      background: #3F6BB6;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
      background: #f4f7fc;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-table tbody tr:hover {
      background: #eaf0fa;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-table td:last-child {
      color: #203f73;
      font-family: "Courier New", Courier, monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-empty-message {
      padding: 2rem 1rem;
      color: #555555;
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .sdsc-app .sdsc-textarea:focus-visible,
    .sdsc-app .sdsc-button:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(63, 104, 182, 0.4);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 800px) {
      .sdsc-app .sdsc-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .sdsc-app .sdsc-textarea {
        min-height: 230px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      body { padding: 0.5rem; }

      .sdsc-app .sdsc-card-body {
        padding: 0.9rem;
      }

      .sdsc-app .sdsc-table th,
      .sdsc-app .sdsc-table td {
        padding: 0.62rem;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>

<main class="sdsc-app">
  <div class="sdsc-layout">

    <section class="sdsc-card" aria-labelledby="sdsc-input-heading">
      <div class="sdsc-card-header" id="sdsc-input-heading">
        Input data
      </div>

      <div class="sdsc-card-body">
        <label class="sdsc-label" for="sdsc-data-input">
          Enter sample data separated by spaces, commas, tabs, or line breaks:
        </label>

        <textarea
          class="sdsc-textarea"
          id="sdsc-data-input"
          placeholder="For example:&#10;1 2 3 4 5&#10;or 1,2,3,4,5"
          aria-describedby="sdsc-input-help sdsc-error sdsc-notice">1 2 3 4 5</textarea>

        <p class="sdsc-help" id="sdsc-input-help">
          Invalid entries are ignored. Sample variance and sample standard
          deviation require at least two valid observations.
        </p>

        <button class="sdsc-button" id="sdsc-calculate" type="button">
          Calculate statistics
        </button>

        <div
          class="sdsc-error"
          id="sdsc-error"
          role="alert"
          aria-live="assertive">
        </div>

        <div
          class="sdsc-notice"
          id="sdsc-notice"
          role="status"
          aria-live="polite">
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="sdsc-card" aria-labelledby="sdsc-results-heading">
      <div class="sdsc-card-header" id="sdsc-results-heading">
        Sample statistics
      </div>

      <div class="sdsc-card-body">
        <div class="sdsc-table-wrapper">
          <table class="sdsc-table" id="sdsc-stats-table">
            <caption class="sdsc-table-caption" id="sdsc-table-caption">
              Statistics for the valid numerical observations.
            </caption>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col">Statistic</th>
                <th scope="col">Value</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="sdsc-stats-body"></tbody>
          </table>

          <div class="sdsc-empty-message" id="sdsc-empty-message" hidden>
            Enter sample data and select Calculate statistics.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

  </div>
</main>

<script>
(function() {
  "use strict";

  const sdscRoot = document.querySelector(".sdsc-app");
  if (!sdscRoot) return;

  const sdscDataInput = sdscRoot.querySelector("#sdsc-data-input");
  const sdscCalculateButton = sdscRoot.querySelector("#sdsc-calculate");
  const sdscError = sdscRoot.querySelector("#sdsc-error");
  const sdscNotice = sdscRoot.querySelector("#sdsc-notice");
  const sdscTable = sdscRoot.querySelector("#sdsc-stats-table");
  const sdscTableCaption = sdscRoot.querySelector("#sdsc-table-caption");
  const sdscStatsBody = sdscRoot.querySelector("#sdsc-stats-body");
  const sdscEmptyMessage = sdscRoot.querySelector("#sdsc-empty-message");

  function sdscParseInput(text) {
    const sdscTokens = text
      .trim()
      .split(/[,\s\t\r\n]+/)
      .filter(Boolean);

    const sdscValues = [];
    const sdscInvalidTokens = [];

    sdscTokens.forEach(function(sdscToken) {
      const sdscValue = Number(sdscToken);

      if (Number.isFinite(sdscValue)) {
        sdscValues.push(sdscValue);
      } else {
        sdscInvalidTokens.push(sdscToken);
      }
    });

    return {
      values: sdscValues,
      invalidTokens: sdscInvalidTokens,
      tokenCount: sdscTokens.length
    };
  }

  /* Matches R's default quantile method, type = 7. */
  function sdscQuantileType7(sdscSortedValues, sdscProbability) {
    const sdscN = sdscSortedValues.length;

    if (sdscN === 1) return sdscSortedValues[0];

    const sdscIndex = (sdscN - 1) * sdscProbability;
    const sdscLowerIndex = Math.floor(sdscIndex);
    const sdscUpperIndex = Math.ceil(sdscIndex);
    const sdscWeight = sdscIndex - sdscLowerIndex;

    if (sdscLowerIndex === sdscUpperIndex) {
      return sdscSortedValues[sdscLowerIndex];
    }

    return sdscSortedValues[sdscLowerIndex] * (1 - sdscWeight) +
      sdscSortedValues[sdscUpperIndex] * sdscWeight;
  }

  function sdscMedian(sdscSortedValues) {
    return sdscQuantileType7(sdscSortedValues, 0.5);
  }

  function sdscMode(sdscValues) {
    const sdscCounts = new Map();
    const sdscOrder = [];

    sdscValues.forEach(function(sdscValue) {
      const sdscKey = Object.is(sdscValue, -0) ? 0 : sdscValue;

      if (!sdscCounts.has(sdscKey)) {
        sdscCounts.set(sdscKey, 0);
        sdscOrder.push(sdscKey);
      }

      sdscCounts.set(sdscKey, sdscCounts.get(sdscKey) + 1);
    });

    const sdscMaximumFrequency = Math.max(...sdscCounts.values());

    if (sdscMaximumFrequency === 1) {
      return "No mode";
    }

    return sdscOrder
      .filter(function(sdscValue) {
        return sdscCounts.get(sdscValue) === sdscMaximumFrequency;
      })
      .map(sdscFormatNumber)
      .join(", ");
  }

  function sdscFormatNumber(sdscValue) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(sdscValue)) return "Not defined";

    if (Math.abs(sdscValue) >= 1e9 ||
        (Math.abs(sdscValue) > 0 && Math.abs(sdscValue) < 1e-6)) {
      return sdscValue.toExponential(6);
    }

    return Number(sdscValue.toPrecision(6)).toString();
  }

  function sdscCalculateStatistics(sdscValues) {
    const sdscSortedValues = [...sdscValues].sort(function(a, b) {
      return a - b;
    });

    const sdscN = sdscValues.length;
    const sdscMinimum = sdscSortedValues[0];
    const sdscMaximum = sdscSortedValues[sdscN - 1];
    const sdscMean = sdscValues.reduce(function(sdscTotal, sdscValue) {
      return sdscTotal + sdscValue;
    }, 0) / sdscN;
    const sdscQ1 = sdscQuantileType7(sdscSortedValues, 0.25);
    const sdscQ3 = sdscQuantileType7(sdscSortedValues, 0.75);

    let sdscVariance = NaN;

    if (sdscN >= 2) {
      const sdscSumSquaredDeviations = sdscValues.reduce(
        function(sdscTotal, sdscValue) {
          return sdscTotal + Math.pow(sdscValue - sdscMean, 2);
        },
        0
      );

      sdscVariance = sdscSumSquaredDeviations / (sdscN - 1);
    }

    return [
      ["Sample size", String(sdscN)],
      ["Minimum", sdscFormatNumber(sdscMinimum)],
      ["Maximum", sdscFormatNumber(sdscMaximum)],
      ["Mean", sdscFormatNumber(sdscMean)],
      ["Mode", sdscMode(sdscValues)],
      ["Median", sdscFormatNumber(sdscMedian(sdscSortedValues))],
      ["Range", sdscFormatNumber(sdscMaximum - sdscMinimum)],
      ["Lower quartile (Q1)", sdscFormatNumber(sdscQ1)],
      ["Upper quartile (Q3)", sdscFormatNumber(sdscQ3)],
      ["Interquartile range (IQR)", sdscFormatNumber(sdscQ3 - sdscQ1)],
      ["Sample variance", sdscFormatNumber(sdscVariance)],
      ["Sample standard deviation", sdscFormatNumber(Math.sqrt(sdscVariance))]
    ];
  }

  function sdscRenderRows(sdscRows) {
    sdscStatsBody.innerHTML = "";

    sdscRows.forEach(function(sdscRow) {
      const sdscTableRow = document.createElement("tr");
      const sdscStatisticCell = document.createElement("td");
      const sdscValueCell = document.createElement("td");

      sdscStatisticCell.textContent = sdscRow[0];
      sdscValueCell.textContent = sdscRow[1];

      sdscTableRow.appendChild(sdscStatisticCell);
      sdscTableRow.appendChild(sdscValueCell);
      sdscStatsBody.appendChild(sdscTableRow);
    });
  }

  function sdscCalculate() {
    const sdscParsed = sdscParseInput(sdscDataInput.value);

    if (sdscParsed.values.length === 0) {
      sdscError.textContent = "No valid numerical data were found.";
      sdscNotice.textContent = "";
      sdscDataInput.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
      sdscStatsBody.innerHTML = "";
      sdscTable.hidden = true;
      sdscEmptyMessage.hidden = false;
      sdscEmptyMessage.textContent = "No statistics are available.";
      return;
    }

    sdscError.textContent = "";
    sdscDataInput.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "false");

    if (sdscParsed.invalidTokens.length > 0) {
      const sdscPreview = sdscParsed.invalidTokens.slice(0, 5).join(", ");
      const sdscAdditional = sdscParsed.invalidTokens.length > 5
        ? ` and ${sdscParsed.invalidTokens.length - 5} more`
        : "";

      sdscNotice.textContent =
        `${sdscParsed.invalidTokens.length} invalid entr` +
        `${sdscParsed.invalidTokens.length === 1 ? "y was" : "ies were"} ` +
        `ignored: ${sdscPreview}${sdscAdditional}.`;
    } else {
      sdscNotice.textContent =
        `${sdscParsed.values.length} valid observation` +
        `${sdscParsed.values.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} analysed.`;
    }

    const sdscRows = sdscCalculateStatistics(sdscParsed.values);
    sdscRenderRows(sdscRows);

    sdscTableCaption.textContent =
      `Statistics for ${sdscParsed.values.length} valid numerical ` +
      `observation${sdscParsed.values.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`;

    sdscTable.hidden = false;
    sdscEmptyMessage.hidden = true;
  }

  sdscCalculateButton.addEventListener("click", sdscCalculate);

  sdscDataInput.addEventListener("keydown", function(sdscEvent) {
    if ((sdscEvent.ctrlKey || sdscEvent.metaKey) && sdscEvent.key === "Enter") {
      sdscEvent.preventDefault();
      sdscCalculate();
    }
  });

  sdscCalculate();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

```
